lat: qdert nsali l-khedma l-bare7
en: I was able to finish the work yesterday.

lat: ma qdertsh nerqed l-bare7 f l-lil
en: I couldn't sleep last night.

lat: wash qderti tji 3ndna l-bare7
en: Were you able to come to our place yesterday?

lat: ma qdertish tshri l-khobz l-bare7
en: You couldn't buy the bread yesterday.

lat: qderti tfehmi d-dars b wa7dek
en: You (f.) were able to understand the lesson by yourself.

lat: ma qdertish tmshi m3ana l-bare7
en: You (f.) couldn't go with us yesterday.

lat: khuya qder yfta7 l-bab
en: My brother was able to open the door.

lat: ma qdersh yji l-yum 7it huwa mrid
ar: ما قدرش يجي اليوم حيت هو مريض
en: He couldn't come today because he is sick.

lat: mama qedrat tteyeb l-3sha b sri3
en: Mom was able to cook dinner quickly.

lat: khti ma qedratsh t7mel l-kis b wa7dha
ar: ختي ما قدراتش تحمل الكيس بوحدها
en: My sister couldn't carry the bag by herself.

lat: qderna nwslu f l-waqt
en: We were able to arrive on time.

lat: ma qdernash nkhrju mn d-dar b sbab sh-shta
ar: ما قدرناش نخرجو من الدار بسبب الشتا
en: We couldn't leave the house because of the rain.

lat: qdertu tkhdemu hadshi kamel b wa7dkum
en: You (pl.) were able to do all this by yourselves.

lat: ma qdertush tl7qu t-tobis l-yum
en: You (pl.) couldn't catch the bus today.

lat: l-wlad qedru yl3bu f l-7ay l-yum
en: The kids were able to play in the neighborhood today.

lat: ma qedrush ysm3u l-ustad f l-qism
en: They couldn't hear the teacher in class.

lat: kanqder nhder b d-darija shwiya
en: I can speak Darija a little.

lat: ma kanqdersh nkhdem f l-lil
en: I can't work at night.

lat: wash katqder tjib liya l-ma 3afak
ar: واش كتقدر تجيب ليا الما عافاك
en: Can you bring me water, please?

lat: ma katqdersh tkhrej bla ma tgul liya
ar: ما كتقدرش تخرج بلا ما تقول ليا
en: You can't go out without telling me.

lat: katqedri tji m3aya l s-suq ila bghiti
ar: كتقدري تجي معايا للسوق ايلا بغيتي
en: You (f.) can come with me to the market if you want.

lat: ma katqedrish tji bla khtek
en: You (f.) can't come without your sister.

lat: baba kayqder ysuq t-tumubil
en: My dad can drive the car.

lat: jeddi ma kayqdersh ymshi bzaf
en: My grandfather can't walk much.

lat: Salma katqder tghenni mezyan
en: Salma can sing well.

lat: mama ma katqdersh tteyeb bla l-bsel
ar: ماما ما كتقدرش تطيب بلا البصل
en: Mom can't cook without onions.

lat: kanqedru njiw nhar s-sebt
en: We can come on Saturday.

lat: ma kanqedrush nmshiw l l-b7er f sh-shta
en: We can't go to the beach in winter.

lat: wash katqedru tjiw m3ana l l-3sha
en: Can you (pl.) come with us to dinner?

lat: ma katqedrush tdkhlu mn had l-bab
ar: ما كتقدروش تدخلو من هاد الباب
en: You (pl.) can't enter through this door.

lat: l-wlad kayqedru yjriw bzaf
en: The kids can run a lot.

lat: n-nas ma kayqedrush yshufu mn hna
ar: الناس ما كيقدروش يشوفو من هنا
en: People can't see from here.

lat: ghadi nqder nji m3akum l-jem3a l-jaya
ar: غادي نقدر نجي معاكم الجمعة الجاية
en: I'm going to be able to come with you (pl.) next Friday.

lat: ma ghadish nqder nji l l-7efla ghedda
ar: ما غاديش نقدر نجي للحفلة غدا
en: I won't be able to come to the party tomorrow.

lat: ghadi tqder tshri hadshi b ghir 3shrin derhem
ar: غادي تقدر تشري هادشي بغير عشرين درهم
en: You'll be able to buy this for only twenty dirhams.

lat: ma ghadish tqder tnsa had nhar
ar: ما غاديش تقدر تنسى هاد النهار
en: You won't be able to forget this day.

lat: ghadi tqedri tsuqi mnin tkberi
en: You (f.) will be able to drive when you grow up.

lat: ma ghadish tqedri tkhrji mn d-dar l-lila
ar: ما غاديش تقدري تخرجي من الدار الليلة
en: You (f.) won't be able to leave the house tonight.

lat: huwa ghadi yqder yzur jeddu f l-3id
ar: هو غادي يقدر يزور جدو فالعيد
en: He'll be able to visit his grandfather at Eid.

lat: ma ghadish yqder ytl3 l-jbel 7it huwa 3yan
ar: ما غاديش يقدر يطلع الجبل حيت هو عيان
en: He won't be able to climb the mountain because he is tired.

lat: Salma ghadi tqder tkhdem mn d-dar
ar: سلمى غادي تقدر تخدم من الدار
en: Salma will be able to work from home.

lat: khti ma ghadish tqder tnam f had d-dar
ar: ختي ما غاديش تقدر تنام فهاد الدار
en: My sister won't be able to sleep in this house.

lat: ghadi nqedru nsafru f s-sif
en: We'll be able to travel in summer.

lat: ma ghadish nqedru nkhelsu l-kra had sh-shher
ar: ما غاديش نقدرو نخلصو الكرا هاد الشهر
en: We won't be able to pay the rent this month.

lat: ghadi tqedru tshufu d-dar ghedda
en: You (pl.) will be able to see the house tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish tqedru tdkhlu bla ma tkhelsu
ar: ما غاديش تقدرو تدخلو بلا ما تخلصو
en: You (pl.) won't be able to enter without paying.

lat: l-3mal ghadi yqedru ysaliw l-khedma qbel l-3id
ar: العمال غادي يقدرو يسالو الخدمة قبل العيد
en: The workers will be able to finish the work before Eid.

lat: ma ghadish yqedru yjiw m3ana ghedda
ar: ما غاديش يقدرو يجيو معانا غدا
en: They won't be able to come with us tomorrow.
